newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to sell 60 pct of Retevision.
newsitem.headline: Spain to sell 60 pct of Retevision.

text.p: Spain's government said on Friday it would privatise the first tranche of 60 percent in state telecommunications group Retevision at a minimum purchase price of 45 billion pesetas.
The privatisation should take place in April.
The initial 60 percent stake will be sold at a restricted auction which will be called in 30 days.
Up until now, the only investor groups showing interest in buying a stake in Retevision have been Banco Central Hispano, France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom.
Utility firms Endesa and Union Fenosa have also showed interest.
Retevision will become Spain's second telephone operator, with government permission to compete with Telefonica in its main business.
Retevision is expected to start this service from the end of 1997.

Spain's government said it expected to end Retevision's privatisation process by the year 2000. It has not yet decided if the initial buyers would have a preferred option over the remaining 40 percent or not.
